analysis.insight_summary: A user encounters issues attempting to install [product_name] [version_no] after upgrading their desktop to Windows 10. Another participant clarifies that this version is not supported with Windows 10 and only a newer release is compatible, suggesting a lack of clear communication regarding software support on modern operating systems. This results in confusion for users trying to use older software after OS upgrades.
